environment.description: Flask application deployed on a single EC2 instance with direct internet-facing access via security group allowing TCP/8080 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0. Environment variable SESSION_SECRET is set to 'production-key-2024' which was leaked in a public GitHub commit (commit sha: a3f8c91). No reverse proxy or load balancer in front of the application. Application runs as root user in a Docker container with --privileged flag.

config.network: Security group allows all inbound on 8080
